name: keenetic
description: Safely diagnose and manage Keenetic and Netcraze routers

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and control a Keenetic router
interface.longDescription: Ask about your home network in plain language: which devices are connected, what is using the bandwidth, how the Wi-Fi looks, why the internet is down. Change what needs changing, safely: nothing is saved until you ask, a backup is taken before the first change, and every change is read back and verified. Talks to the router over your LAN with nothing installed on the router itself.
defaultPrompt: Which devices are on my network right now, and what is using the most bandwidth?
